title: Tables read directly by pre-aggregation SQL must be in the pytest ClickHouse schema
answers: Test fails because web_pre_aggregated_teams table does not exist
Adding a ClickHouse table to posthog/clickhouse/schema.py and the schema snapshot
test_schema.ambr snapshot update for a new table
body:
The job now reads `web_pre_aggregated_teams` directly, so its CREATE statement, WEB_PRE_AGGREGATED_TEAM_SELECTION_TABLE_SQL, was added to the table list in posthog/clickhouse/schema.py.
posthog/clickhouse/test/__snapshots__/test_schema.ambr also needed matching `test_create_table_query[...]` and `test_create_table_query_replicated_and_storage[...]` entries.
Any SQL that reads a table in tests needs it registered in schema.py, and the snapshot must be regenerated alongside.
applies: Adding or newly depending on a ClickHouse table in test environments
